decisions.summary: the E2 row hem_to_bank#drain with the fall left alone is fixed by changing the implementation (a vertex in a with-the-fall collector is moved out of the water), not by relabeling the UNRESEARCHED claim
decisions.why: FR-004 (the implementation moves to the research) and the ranking row's own fix ('lift vertices off a drain running with the fall'); 0055's drawing keeps the field edge 'out of its water'; the GM: 'I'm not sure there's any reason for our implementation to not match for anything'

decisions.id: W79-2 perpendicular step onto its own side
decisions.summary: where lean < 0.2 the vertex steps off at right angles to the drain's nearest segment, onto the bank of the side it already lies on, ending need off the centerline (off_with_the_fall)
decisions.why: the ranking row names exactly this ('perpendicular move when lean < 0.2'); the nearer bank is the least move that clears the water, and nothing in the request or spec settles a different side

decisions.id: W79-3 inside the bank on either side
decisions.summary: for a with-the-fall drain the move applies where |gap| < need (either side), not gap < need, since gap's up-fall sign means nothing for such a drain
decisions.why: it moves every vertex standing in the water and none that is clear (the unit test pins both); it narrows nothing - no in-water vertex is left unmoved

decisions.summary: a vertex exactly on the centerline goes to the segment's left
decisions.why: an arbitrary but deterministic tie-break inside the requested fix; neither the request nor the spec speaks to it and it leaves no vertex in the water

decisions.id: W79-5 the array walk changed alike
decisions.summary: hem_rings_to_bank gets the same branch and its claim the same 0055 citation, though its own row is scope: deferred (dev/claims-deferred.json) and no engine code calls it
decisions.why: not a narrowing (it removes no requested work); it keeps the function's own stated contract ('Each ring comes back as hem_to_bank would return it') and the existing equivalence test true, which leaving it would have broken (constitution XIV); it draws no legacy map (no caller), so FR-009 is untouched; waves.json marks only the kept row 79

decisions.why: FR-005's batched verification as the GM ruled 2026-10-08; the pool unchanged (m:wave79-off-with-the-fall), so no map regeneration or FR-008 Decisions Recorded entry is owed
